data.narrative:
Dawn Aerospace is a Series B space and aerospace company that has raised $25M to date. Valuation assessment draws from a peer universe of 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private-stage companies in the same sector, including Sierra Space, Cowboy Space Corporation, Varda Space Industries, Aalyria, and Skyryse.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis, using the $25M total raised as a proxy base value and applying a 1.9x multiplier typical of Series B progression, yields $48M. Peer-median analysis across the 5 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables produces $1.5B, anchored to a median valuation of $1.5B with a range spanning $1.1B (Skyryse) to $8.0B (Sierra Space). Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiple (sector median 23.9x across 6 tickers) is not applicable due to absence of target revenue disclosure.

The triangulated range is $40M to $1.7B, with a median of $774M. The substantial spread reflects material stage-related dispersion within the peer set—Series C companies command valuations materially above Series B benchmarks. Key uncertainties center on Dawn Aerospace's revenue trajectory relative to peers, technology validation progress, and whether the company's position warrants valuation toward the Series B median (Aalyria, Cowboy Space at $1.3B–$2.0B) or below. Public-comp anchoring remains unavailable pending revenue disclosure.
